desc:
🌻 Build the farm of your dreams in Sunshine Valley, a cozy farming & life simulator where every season brings something new.

🌱 Grow seasonal crops and discover rare harvests
🐔 Raise animals, adopt pets and care for your farm
🎣 Fish rivers, ponds and the ocean for changing catches
⛏️ Explore deep mines, battle monsters and uncover treasure
🍳 Cook recipes, craft useful items and turn harvests into something more
🏡 Expand your land, upgrade your farmhouse and decorate it your way
💛 Befriend the valley’s residents, give gifts and discover their stories
✨ Recruit magical Sunshine Sprites to help farm, fish, forage and care for animals
🎉 Experience birthdays, celebrations and changing seasons
👥 Visit friends’ farms, lend a hand, leave likes, sign guestbooks and exchange gifts

✨ Farm. Fish. Mine. Cook. Decorate. Make friends. Chase collections. Or simply slow down and watch the seasons roll on by ✨

Your little patch of sunshine is waiting! ☀️
